description: Tests whether an agent can compress a growing context into a minimal representation while preserving essential reasoning elements.

steps.instruction: Start the task: design a system for managing personal knowledge notes. Define entities, relationships, and basic workflows. Provide a moderately detailed structure.
Extend the system with additional features: tagging, search, and version history. Update your design accordingly.
The context is now too large. Compress your current design into a minimal structured representation that preserves all essential elements.
Using only your compressed representation, continue the design and provide a final structured solution.
